passages.provision_quote: California law enforcement agencies shall not: (1) Use agency or department moneys or personnel to investigate, interrogate, detain, detect, or arrest persons for immigration enforcement purposes
passages.note: The cooperation carve-out (7282.5) reaches far beyond serious violent crimes (theft, fraud, DUI, bribery, drug trafficking, etc.), so this does not match rung 2's exact clause.
Assembly Floor final-passage vote page shows Aguiar-Curry voting Aye on the single-subject bill.

rows.reasoning: SB 54 (2017-2018) bars state and local law enforcement from using resources to assist federal immigration enforcement, but its own cooperation exception (Sec. 7282.5) is not limited to 'serious violent crimes' as rung 2 states -- it also covers many non-violent offenses (theft, fraud, DUI, bribery, drug trafficking). Her Aye vote on this single-subject bill shows a protective direction on deportation cooperation but does not chair-shape any one rung's exact clause.
